script_text: Quiet your mind, Aquarius, because the cosmos is forcing a confrontation you can no longer ignore. Uranus, your ruling planet, is currently forming a tense square to Saturn in your 10th House of public reputation and career structure. This friction creates a sudden clash between your need for radical freedom and the rigid demands of your professional obligations. In love, a trine from Venus to your 5th House suggests a spontaneous, electrifying encounter with someone who mirrors your intellectual eccentricity. Regarding your finances, watch your 2nd House closely, as a volatile transit suggests an unexpected expenditure linked to a sudden technological upgrade. Avoid making any impulsive long-term contracts until the moon shifts houses tonight. Follow for tomorrow's reading to see how this tension resolves.
